budgets:code_rule_reservation_available.finding: Budget feasibility can be checked from an existing line item and requested amounts; a historical BudgetReservation record is not an input to this comparison.
budgets:code_rule_reservation_available.applicability: For a proposed request, aggregate its estimatedTotalAmount values by lineItem and compare with the freshly read LineItem.availableAmount (the code uses zero when the stored value is missing). This is a source-backed comparison, not transaction execution or proof of the balance at a past date.
request_inputs: Requested line-item IDs and corresponding amounts. These are request inputs, not missing database collections.
conditional_requirements: Actual BudgetReservation records are needed only to identify individual historical reservations, their PR ownership, or active/released/converted lifecycle. Current availableAmount alone does not reconstruct them.

procurement:code_rule_approved_pr.finding: The requisition guard runs only inside if (body.purchaseRequestId). An independent purchase order follows the department branch without requiring a requisition record.
procurement:code_rule_approved_pr.applicability: First read the actual purchase order or supplied request to establish whether it has purchaseRequestId. Only a populated link triggers requisition-specific approval validation; do not demand a PR for ordinary PO totals, vendor, amount, status, budget or receipt questions.

available_evidence.role: Direct PO facts; inspect a requisition link only when supplied or actually present

conditional_requirements: A genuinely linked PR requires its own approval evidence; a PO approval is not a substitute for PR approval. Absence of the field in historical records does not prove why that historical application omitted it.

approvals:finance_stages.finding: A stage is independently recorded evidence. Its history remains usable even when its approval parent cannot be retrieved.
approvals:finance_stages.applicability: Read stages using approvalId, retaining each source _id. Report recorded StageNumber, status, approved flag, actor fields, stageDate and comments directly. Try exact approvals._id, inverse approvals.stages, document approvalId backlinks and embedded report snapshots before requiring parent-only fields.

available_evidence.role: Stage facts and recorded action history

conditional_requirements: An approved stage does not establish final parent approval. Never infer a document identity, configuration, final decision, approver identity beyond the stored actor, or unrecorded date from a coincident numeric ID.
